# Contextify contributor context

## Commands
- Run every test suite and the self-dogfood check with `make test`.
- Run the drift and writer fixtures alone with `python3 tests/test_ctx_check.py`.
- Run claim resolver fixtures alone with `python3 tests/test_verify_claims.py`.
- Check the skill contract with `python3 evals/check_skill.py skills/contextify/SKILL.md`.
- Check that this repository's own context is fresh with `make dogfood`.

## Boundaries
- Keep scripts dependency-free and omit AI attribution trailers from commits; see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- `skills/contextify/SKILL.md` requires a separate verifier before `skills/contextify/scripts/ctx_write.py` applies a draft.

## Read when relevant
- [Architecture](docs/context/architecture.md)
- [Workflows](docs/context/workflows.md)
